name: Singleton--Edge Record Coarsening
definition: Let the common section be the singleton $D=\{d\}$ and let $A=\{d,a\}$ be an edge rooted at $d$.
properties: The record sets differ: $\operatorname{Tr}_D(D)=\{((d),\varnothing)\}$, whereas $\operatorname{Tr}_D(A)=\{((d),\varnothing),((d),\{d\})\}$. Nevertheless $A$ and $D$ are interchangeable over $D$, because the edge peels down to its root. Thus equality of record sets is strictly finer than gluing behavior.
